request_body.title: Juniper measurement coverage audit
request_body.text: Juniper measurement coverage audit for runs P21 and P22. Peak resident set size (peak RSS) was not measured for either run. No memory telemetry or memory artifact was retained for P21 or P22. The machine's 32 GiB installed RAM is a hardware capacity, not either run's peak RSS. Latency and omitted-record rate cannot recover peak RSS. This audit contains no numerical estimate of either run's memory consumption.
